source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of quality assurance (PDF 19).

blocks.text: Quality assurance yaqeeni banati hai ke project tay shuda standards (qaide aur paimane) poore kare aur theek kaam kare. Is mein yeh tareeqe shamil hain: testing, code ka review (jaanch), stakeholders se feedback lena aur project ki progress ko regular taur par check karna.
Misal: software project mein is ka matlab yeh yaqeeni banana hai ke code sahi likha gaya ho aur waisa hi kaam kare jaisa umeed hai.

blocks.prompt: Quality assurance ke chaar tareeqe likhein.
blocks.explanation: Testing, code review, stakeholders se feedback lena aur project ki progress ko regular taur par check karna.

items: Quality assurance: project standards poore kare aur theek chale; tareeqe: testing, code review, feedback, progress ki jaanch.
